assumptions.choice: Use the current ATR and preceding 251 ATR values; the 20th-percentile cutoff uses linear interpolation, and equality is allowed.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define percentile interpolation or whether the current ATR belongs to the 252-bar lookback.

assumptions.choice: Do not permit entries until 252 valid ATR observations are available.
assumptions.reason: A 252-bar percentile is undefined before its full stated window exists.

assumptions.choice: Convert $1,000 to shares using the signal bar close.
assumptions.reason: Market orders fill on the next bar, so the exact filled notional cannot be known when the order is submitted.
The fixed execution environment explicitly supplies starting cash, while the specification does not define capital as current equity.

assumptions.choice: Submit the exit once five bars have elapsed after the entry order is completed.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define whether the fill bar itself counts as one of the five bars.
